title: Uncertainty Propagation in Stochastic Hybrid Systems with Dimension-Varying Resets
summary: This paper studies probability density evolution for stochastic hybrid systems with reset maps that change the dimension of the continuous state across modes. Existing Frobenius--Perron formulations typically represent reset-induced probability transfer through boundary conditions, which is insufficient when resets map guard sets into the interior or onto lower-dimensional subsets of another mode.
